ticket.summary: Homeowner requesting quote for proactive replacement of 14-year-old 40-gal gas water heater in garage; quote only, will call back in ~1 week.

quote_lines.description: 40-gal gas water heater replacement, installed (includes tank, old unit removal/disposal, reconnection, reuse of serviceable existing vent connector). Permit pulled by Brookdale; municipal permit fee is a pass-through TBD. Vent replacement/re-routing quoted on site if needed.

ticket.customer_message: Yes - same number, +1-555-0114 reaches us, and someone answers during business hours. I've logged the quote under 61 Foxtail Dr: $1,450 for a 40-gal gas replacement, permit pulled by us, plan on about 4.5 hours on site. Reach out whenever you're ready and we'll get you on the calendar - and if the old unit starts leaking or you ever smell gas before then, get everyone out and call the gas utility or 911 from outside. Thanks, Hal!
